blocks.text: Which Cruise Ports Serve Orange County Travelers?
Most Orange County residents depart from two major cruise terminals.

blocks.text: Port of Los Angeles (San Pedro)

Located approximately 35–50 miles from much of Orange County, the Port of Los Angeles is one of the busiest cruise ports on the West Coast. It serves major cruise lines offering itineraries to Mexico, Hawaii, Alaska, and the Panama Canal.

blocks.text: Port of Long Beach
Located closer to Orange County, the Port of Long Beach is another popular departure point. It is well known for cruises to Mexico, Baja California, and other Pacific destinations.
